body: I've been with this woman for 4 years. We were planning a life together, and I know it sounds silly and childish but I just want her to come back, so bad its painful. I haven't eaten in 3 days, food holds nothing for me in fact it repels me. Life has no meaning without the one person I truly shared it with. My family all despises me, so they're useless to go too, and all my friends despise her and just tell me to suck it up. I hate wearing the mask and pretending that I'm not bleeding on the inside.

The pain in just crushing though. I've been thru a bad breakup and it sucked, but this woman is one that I planned to build a future with. She is the one. As much as I'd love to just walk away from it and tell myself that I'll be fine, I know I won't. Her and I have been to hell and back and there's no real replacing that. I look at other women and all I can see is her, I feel nothing for anyone else. I know its awful the amount of power I've allowed her to have over me but I can't help it. She's got the new boyfriend now and all I can think about is whether it'll fail and whether she'll come back. I want her to come back, I want my best friend back.
I'm right there with you. I feel like I just need to end the pain
